profile.optionalUnknownChunks: preserve raw bytes on whole-file roundtrip; do not interpret

profile.readerExecution: data-only; embedded JS is never executed by the reader

definitions.typeOf: Category membership, not physical containment or pose parenting.
definitions.objectId: Persistent logical identity; a content hash identifies a revision, not a new physical object.
definitions.worldTime: Effective physical-world time, explicitly unknown when no evidence exists.
definitions.localFrame: Coordinate frame of the inherited numeric model; not a geographic CRS.
definitions.derivedFrom: Versioned source lineage; independent of physical parentage.
definitions.requiredFor: basic-meaning, full-file-recovery, or rendering; necessity has a declared task scope.
definitions.valueStatus: known, unknown, not-provided, not-applicable, conflict, or not-implemented; zero is a known numerical value only.
definitions.recordedDate: Project record date; never silently interpreted as historical aircraft world time.
definitions.sourceResource: Byte-exact resource in the accepted package, including exact numeric transition and editable code.
definitions.genericTemplate: Reusable digital aircraft baseline; no assertion that this record is a particular historical aircraft.
definitions.evidenceResource: Acceptance/documentation material; not runtime geometry and not proof of historical accuracy.
definitions.poseReferencedTo: A reference-frame relation; must not be inferred from type or project ownership.
definitions.visualAcceptance: User acceptance of displayed appearance; does not establish manufacturing calibration.
definitions.normalizedService: Illustrative 0..1 appearance state; not elapsed hours or dates.
definitions.plannedDerivative: A future work direction only; no historical instance, crew membership, or identifying number is fabricated.
definitions.representationPartOf: A named region of this digital baseline; source node IDs identify its inherited representation.

VOCB.numericPolicy: Integers retain exact signed/unsigned values through 64 bits. Binary64 floats remain binary64. This profile uses no implicit defaults.
